sn35.134:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Devadahannāma Sakkānam nigame || || 2
sn35.134:1.3: Nāham bhikkhave sabbesaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi || Na ca panāham bhikkhave sabbesaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu nāppamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi || || 3
sn35.134:1.4: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhiṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā || tesāham bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu nāppamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi || ||
sn35.134:1.6: Kataṃ tesam appamādena || abhabbā te pamajjituṃ || || 5
sn35.134:1.7: Ye ca kho te bhikkhave bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemam patthayamānā viharanti || tesāham bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi || ||
sn35.134:1.9: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā manoramā pi amanoramā pi ||
sn35.134:1.10: tyāssa phussaphussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti ||
sn35.134:1.11: cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyam asallīnaṃ || upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā || passaddho kāyo asāraddho || samāhitaṃ cittam ekaggaṃ || ||
sn35.134:1.12: Imaṃ khvāham bhikkhave appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesam bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi || || 7,8,9,10 Pe ||
sn35.134:1.13: Santi bhikkhave jivhā- kāya- || || 11 Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā manoramā pi amanoramā pi ||
sn35.134:1.14: tyāssa phussaphussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti ||
sn35.134:1.15: cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyam asallīnaṃ || upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā || passaddho kāyo asāraddho || samāhitaṃ cittam ekaggaṃ || ||
sn35.134:1.16: Imam khvāham bhikkhave appamādaphalam sampassamāno tesam bhikkhūnam chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmīti || || 2
